run_f_gold: run f_gold to calculate minimum cost to cut a board into squares given horizontal and vertical cut costs
test_f_gold: test f_gold with lists of horizontal and vertical cut costs and their counts
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating input lists by sorting copies instead of in place
review_f_gold: review f_gold greedy algorithm that processes most expensive cuts first to minimize total board cutting cost
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes minimum cost to cut a board into m+1 by n+1 squares
